# FleetCommanderCacheLib
[Git Source](https://github.com/OasisDEX/summer-earn-protocol/blob/main/packages/core-contracts/src/contracts/libraries/FleetCommanderCacheLib.sol)

**Title:**
FleetCommanderCacheLib - Caching Utility Library

This library provides the core logic for the caching mechanism used in the FleetCommander suite.
It handles asset tracking, ark data management, rebalance flow calculations, and persistent state
storage using transient-like behavior in storage slots.


## Functions
### isCollectingTip

Checks if the FleetCommander is currently performing a transaction that includes a tip


```solidity
function isCollectingTip() public view returns (bool);
```
**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`<none>`|`bool`|bool True if collecting tips, false otherwise|

Sets the isCollectingTip flag in storage


```solidity
function setIsCollectingTip(bool value) public;
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`value`|`bool`|The value to set the flag to|


### totalAssets

Calculates the total assets across all given arks

Checks if total assets are already cached. If so, returns the cached value.
Otherwise, calculates the sum across all active arks and the buffer ark.


```solidity
function totalAssets(IArk bufferArk, address[] memory activeArks) public view returns (uint256);
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`bufferArk`|`IArk`|The buffer ark instance|
|`activeArks`|`address[]`|An array of addresses for all active arks|

**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`<none>`|`uint256`|uint256 the sum of total assets across all arks|


### withdrawableTotalAssets

Calculates the total assets that can be withdrawn from the given arks

Checks if withdrawable total assets are already cached. If so, returns the cached value.
Otherwise, iterates through all arks and sums up their withdrawable assets.


```solidity
function withdrawableTotalAssets(
    IArk bufferArk,
    address[] memory activeArks
)
    public
    view
    returns (uint256 withdrawableTotalAssetsSum);
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`bufferArk`|`IArk`|The buffer ark instance|
|`activeArks`|`address[]`|An array of addresses for all active arks|

**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`withdrawableTotalAssetsSum`|`uint256`|The sum of withdrawable assets across all arks|

### flushCache

Resets all caching-related storage slots

This is called at the end of operations to ensure data freshness for subsequent calls.
It flushes total assets, length indicators, and cached array data.


```solidity
function flushCache() public;
```

### getArksData

Retrieves and caches ArkData for all arks and the buffer ark

If the total assets are already cached, it returns the data from the cache.
Otherwise, it fetches total assets from each ark, populates the ArkData struct array,
caches individual ark data, and caches the total assets sum.


```solidity
function getArksData(IArk bufferArk, address[] memory activeArks) public returns (ArkData[] memory _arksData);
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`bufferArk`|`IArk`|The buffer ark instance|
|`activeArks`|`address[]`|Array of active ark addresses|

**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`_arksData`|`ArkData[]`|An array of ArkData structs for all arks (buffer ark is at the end)|

### cacheArkFlow

Tracks rebalance inflow and outflow for specific arks

Updates the total amount moved in or out of an ark during the current execution.
Also ensures that max inflow/outflow limits are cached if not already present.


```solidity
function cacheArkFlow(
    address outflowArkAddress,
    address inflowArkAddress,
    uint256 amount
)
    public
    returns (uint256 newInflowBalance, uint256 newOutflowBalance, uint256 maxInflow, uint256 maxOutflow);
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`outflowArkAddress`|`address`|The address of the ark being disembarked from|
|`inflowArkAddress`|`address`|The address of the ark being boarded|
|`amount`|`uint256`|The amount moved|

**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`newInflowBalance`|`uint256`|Updated total inflow for the destination ark|
|`newOutflowBalance`|`uint256`|Updated total outflow for the source ark|
|`maxInflow`|`uint256`|The maximum allowed inflow for the destination ark|
|`maxOutflow`|`uint256`|The maximum allowed outflow for the source ark|

### getWithdrawableArksData

Identifies, filters, and caches arks that have withdrawable assets

Fetches all ark data, filters those with non-zero withdrawableTotalAssets,

### sortArkDataByTotalAssets

Sorts an ArkData array in place by total assets (ascending)

Uses a simple bubble sort implementation suitable for small fleet sizes.


```solidity

```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`arkDataArray`|`ArkData[]`|The ArkData array to sort|
